snapshot.note: econ.yale.edu/~shiller/data/ie_data.xls is a stale mirror (frozen at 2023-09). Use shillerdata.com.

assumptions: Base case: idle cash holds its real value (0% real). Deliberately the generous assumption for DCA.
Sensitivity: idle cash earns 0% nominal, so it erodes with inflation.
No taxes, no transaction costs, no fund fees.
The holding period is measured from the month of the final purchase.

baseCase.cashPolicy: idle cash holds its real value (0% real)

pathways.Note: The market kept climbing while the drip was still buying, so it bought higher every month. Then 2000 hit both.
The market collapsed while the drip was still buying, so it bought lower every month. This is the case DCA is sold on.
